"""Intake: probes every clip, makes a light edit master when needed, and measures everything the line will use."""

from __future__ import annotations

from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np

from ... import media
from .. import analysis as an
from .. import look
from ..model import AgentRun, Clip
from .base import Agent, Ctx, save_jpg


def ingest(ctx: Ctx, clip: Clip, say) -> bool:
    """Measure one clip. Returns False when it was already measured (nothing to do)."""
    npz = ctx.root / "analysis" / f"{clip.id}.npz"
    if clip.analysis and npz.exists() and clip.master and ctx.abs(clip.master).exists():
        return False
    src = ctx.abs(clip.path)
    info = media.probe(src)
    clip.duration, clip.width, clip.height = info["duration"], info["width"], info["height"]
    clip.fps, clip.has_audio = info["fps"] or 30.0, info["has_audio"]
    fps_a = float(min(np.clip(1500 / max(clip.duration, 1), 2, 10), clip.fps))
    size = an.analysis_size(clip.width, clip.height)
    big = max(clip.width, clip.height) > 1920 or info["vcodec"] not in ("h264",)
    if big:
        msize = an.master_size(clip.width, clip.height)
        out = ctx.root / "media" / f"{clip.id}_master.mp4"
        fr = an.master_and_frames(src, out, msize, fps_a, size, clip.fps, clip.has_audio)
        clip.master = ctx.rel(out)
        say(f"{clip.name}: {clip.width}x{clip.height} {info['vcodec']} → {msize[0]}x{msize[1]} edit master "
            f"(1 s keyframes, every cut seeks instantly)")
    else:
        fr = an.frames(src, fps_a, size)
        clip.master = clip.path
    m = an.measure(fr)
    sx, conf = an.subject_track(fr)
    sxs = an.smooth(sx, max(3, int(round(fps_a * 1.2))))
    clip.cuts = an.detect_cuts(m["hdist"], m["motion"], fps_a)
    edges = [0.0, *clip.cuts, clip.duration]
    clip.shots = [[round(a, 3), round(b, 3)] for a, b in zip(edges, edges[1:])]
    px = look.pixel_sample(fr)
    st = look.stats(px)
    clip.levels = st
    clip.flat = (st["luma"][4] - st["luma"][0] < 0.75) or st["sat"] < 0.12
    sharp_n = an.norm(m["sharp"])
    quality = sharp_n - np.abs(m["bright"] - 0.45) * 1.2 - 2 * (m["hi"] + m["lo"])
    lo, hi = int(len(quality) * 0.1), max(int(len(quality) * 0.9), int(len(quality) * 0.1) + 1)
    clip.best_t = round(float((lo + int(np.argmax(quality[lo:hi]))) / fps_a), 2) if len(quality) else 0.0
    w = np.clip(conf, 1, None)
    clip.subject = round(float((sxs * w).sum() / w.sum()), 3) if len(sxs) else 0.5
    db = np.zeros(1, np.float32)
    if clip.has_audio:
        db = an.envelope_db(an.pcm(ctx.abs(clip.master), 16000), 16000)
        if float(db.max()) < -55:
            clip.has_audio = False
            say(f"{clip.name}: the audio track is silent; treating the clip as silent")
        else:
            clip.sound = an.sound_regions(db)
    npz.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    step = max(1, len(px) // 40000)
    np.savez_compressed(npz, t=np.arange(len(fr), dtype=np.float32) / fps_a, sharp=m["sharp"], motion=m["motion"],
                        bright=m["bright"], sat=m["sat"], hi=m["hi"], lo=m["lo"], hdist=m["hdist"], rgb=m["rgb"],
                        sx=sxs, sx_raw=sx, conf=conf, px=(px[::step] * 255).astype(np.uint8), th=an.thumbs(fr), db=db)
    clip.analysis, clip.analysis_fps = ctx.rel(npz), round(fps_a, 4)
    stills = ctx.root / "stills"
    media.frame(ctx.abs(clip.master), clip.best_t, stills / f"{clip.id}_poster.jpg", height=360)
    clip.poster = f"stills/{clip.id}_poster.jpg"
    idx = np.linspace(0, len(fr) - 1, 8).astype(int) if len(fr) else []
    if len(idx):
        save_jpg(np.concatenate([fr[i] for i in idx], axis=1), stills / f"{clip.id}_strip.jpg")
        clip.filmstrip = f"stills/{clip.id}_strip.jpg"
    return True


class Intake(Agent):
    key, title, icon, color = "intake", "Intake", "layers", "#7aa2f7"
    role = "probes every clip, builds a light edit master and measures sharpness, motion, exposure, cuts, subject and sound"

    def inputs(self, ctx: Ctx):
        return [(c.id, c.path, c.analysis) for c in ctx.project.clips]

    def run(self, ctx: Ctx, rep: AgentRun) -> None:
        clips = ctx.project.clips
        if not clips:
            raise RuntimeError("no footage: add at least one clip")

        def one(c: Clip) -> bool:
            return ingest(ctx, c, lambda m: self.say(ctx, m))

        with ThreadPoolExecutor(2) as ex:
            fresh = list(ex.map(one, clips))
        for c, new in zip(clips, fresh):
            lv = c.levels
            bits = [f"{c.width}x{c.height} {c.fps:g} fps {c.duration:.1f}s",
                    f"{len(c.cuts)} camera cut{'s' if len(c.cuts) != 1 else ''}",
                    "flat/log colour" if c.flat else "normal contrast",
                    f"subject around x={c.subject:.2f}",
                    f"{len(c.sound)} sound stretches" if c.has_audio else "no sound"]
            self.decide(ctx, rep, f"{c.id} {c.name}: " + " · ".join(bits) + ("" if new else " (measured earlier)"))
            self.check(ctx, rep, f"{c.id} measured", bool(c.analysis) and lv.get("luma") is not None,
                       f"luma {lv['luma'][0]:.2f}–{lv['luma'][4]:.2f}, saturation {lv['sat']:.2f}")
        total = sum(c.duration for c in clips)
        rep.summary = f"{len(clips)} clip{'s' if len(clips) > 1 else ''}, {total:.1f}s of footage measured"
        rep.preview = clips[0].poster

"""Reference Analyst: watches the reference video first and measures how it is edited.

Cut rhythm (shot lengths, bursts of quick cuts), colour (CIELAB mean and spread, black and white points,
saturation, warmth), letterbox, vignette, grain, how much moves, dips to black, and, when it has music,
the tempo and how often the cuts land on the beat. The Cutter and the Colorist then edit the raw footage
the same way.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json

import numpy as np

from ... import media
from .. import analysis as an
from .. import look
from ..model import AgentRun
from .base import Agent, Ctx


def analyse_reference(ctx: Ctx) -> dict:
    ref = ctx.project.reference
    src = ctx.abs(ref.path)
    cache = ctx.root / "analysis" / "reference.json"
    if cache.exists():
        prof = json.loads(cache.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        if prof.get("source") == ref.path:
            return prof
    info = media.probe(src)
    ref.duration, ref.width, ref.height, ref.fps = info["duration"], info["width"], info["height"], info["fps"]
    fps_a = float(np.clip(900 / max(ref.duration, 1), 2, 8))
    size = an.analysis_size(ref.width, ref.height)
    fr = an.frames(src, fps_a, size)
    m = an.measure(fr)
    cuts = an.detect_cuts(m["hdist"], m["motion"], fps_a)
    edges = [0.0, *cuts, ref.duration]
    lens = np.diff(edges)
    inner = lens[1:-1] if len(lens) > 3 else lens
    shots = {"count": int(len(lens)), "median": round(float(np.median(inner)), 2), "mean": round(float(inner.mean()), 2),
             "p10": round(float(np.percentile(inner, 10)), 2), "p90": round(float(np.percentile(inner, 90)), 2),
             "burst_share": round(float((inner < 0.7).mean()), 3), "cuts_per_min": round(len(cuts) / max(ref.duration, 1) * 60, 1)}
    g = (fr.astype(np.float32) / 255) @ an.LUMA
    rows = g.mean((0, 2))
    rows_sd = g.mean(2).std(0)
    dark = (rows < 0.045) & (rows_sd < 0.03)
    top = int(np.argmax(~dark)) if not dark.all() else 0
    bottom = int(np.argmax(~dark[::-1])) if not dark.all() else 0
    h = g.shape[1]
    letterbox = None
    if top / h >= 0.05 and bottom / h >= 0.05:
        active = ref.width / (ref.height * (1 - (top + bottom) / h))
        if active > ref.width / ref.height + 0.12:
            letterbox = round(float(active), 2)
    px = look.pixel_sample(fr, bars=(top, bottom))
    st = look.stats(px)
    gi = g[:, top: h - bottom] if (top or bottom) else g
    hh, ww = gi.shape[1:]
    cy, cx = hh // 5, ww // 5
    corners = np.concatenate([gi[:, :cy, :cx].ravel(), gi[:, :cy, -cx:].ravel(), gi[:, -cy:, :cx].ravel(), gi[:, -cy:, -cx:].ravel()])
    centre = gi[:, 2 * cy:3 * cy, 2 * cx:3 * cx]
    ratio = float(corners.mean() / max(float(centre.mean()), 1e-3))
    vignette = round(float(np.clip((0.92 - ratio) / 0.35, 0, 1)), 2)
    n_noise = 8
    full = an.frames(src, n_noise / max(ref.duration, 1), an.analysis_size(ref.width, ref.height, 960))
    noise = an.noise_level(full[:n_noise])
    dips = int(np.sum(np.diff((m["bright"] < 0.03).astype(int)) == 1))
    prof = {"source": ref.path, "name": ref.name, "duration": round(ref.duration, 2), "shots": shots,
            "letterbox": letterbox, "look": st, "noise": noise, "vignette": vignette,
            "motion": round(float(an.norm(m["motion"], 50).mean()), 3), "motion_raw": round(float(m["motion"].mean()), 4),
            "dips_to_black": dips, "warmth": st["lab_mean"][2], "tempo": None, "on_beat": None, "lufs": None}
    if info["has_audio"]:
        music = an.analyse_music(src)
        beats = np.array(music["beats"])
        if music["tempo"] and len(beats) > 8 and len(cuts) >= 4:
            near = [float(np.min(np.abs(beats - c))) for c in cuts]
            prof["tempo"] = music["tempo"]
            prof["on_beat"] = round(float(np.mean(np.array(near) < 0.07)), 2)
        loud = media.loudness(src)
        prof["lufs"] = loud.get("lufs")
    ctx.root.joinpath("stills").mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    media.frame(src, ref.duration * 0.4, ctx.root / "stills" / "reference_poster.jpg", height=360)
    ref.poster = "stills/reference_poster.jpg"
    cache.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    cache.write_text(json.dumps(prof, indent=1), encoding="utf-8")
    return prof


def describe(prof: dict) -> list[str]:
    s = prof["shots"]
    lab = prof["look"]["lab_mean"]
    warm = "warm" if lab[2] > 8 else "cool" if lab[2] < -2 else "neutral"
    lines = [f"cut rhythm: median shot {s['median']}s (mean {s['mean']}s, {s['cuts_per_min']} cuts/min, "
             f"{round(s['burst_share'] * 100)}% of shots under 0.7s)",
             f"colour: {warm} (b* {lab[2]:+.1f}, a* {lab[1]:+.1f}), lightness {lab[0]:.0f} ± {prof['look']['lab_std'][0]:.0f}, "
             f"saturation {prof['look']['sat']:.2f}, blacks at {prof['look']['luma'][0]:.2f}",
             f"texture: grain {prof['noise']:.1f}, vignette {prof['vignette']:.2f}"
             + (f", letterboxed {prof['letterbox']}:1" if prof.get("letterbox") else "")]
    if prof.get("tempo"):
        lines.append(f"music at {prof['tempo']:.0f} BPM; {round(prof['on_beat'] * 100)}% of cuts land on a beat")
    if prof.get("dips_to_black"):
        lines.append(f"{prof['dips_to_black']} dip(s) to black")
    return lines


class ReferenceAnalyst(Agent):
    key, title, icon, color = "reference", "Reference", "eye", "#bb9af7"
    role = "watches your reference first and measures its rhythm, colour, texture and beat sync"

    def inputs(self, ctx: Ctx):
        r = ctx.project.reference
        return r.path if r else None

    def run(self, ctx: Ctx, rep: AgentRun) -> None:
        if not ctx.project.reference:
            rep.status = "skipped"
            rep.summary = "no reference video: the skill is used as designed"
            return
        prof = analyse_reference(ctx)
        ctx.project.reference.profile = prof
        for line in describe(prof):
            self.decide(ctx, rep, line)

"""Music Supervisor: picks the track and maps it (tempo, beats, downbeats, where it gets loud)."""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np

from ...config import settings
from .. import analysis as an
from ..model import AgentRun, Track
from ..skills import MUSIC_DIR
from .base import Agent, Ctx


def chosen_track(ctx: Ctx) -> tuple[Path, str, str] | None:
    s, p = ctx.settings.music, ctx.project
    if s == "none":
        return None
    if s == "upload" and p.music_upload:
        return ctx.abs(p.music_upload.path), p.music_upload.name, p.music_upload.credit or "your track"
    name = s.split(":", 1)[1] if s and s.startswith("library:") else (ctx.skill.get("sound") or {}).get("music")
    if not name:
        return None
    path = MUSIC_DIR / name
    if not path.exists():
        return None
    title = path.stem.replace("_", " ")
    return path, title, f'"{title}" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), licensed under CC BY 4.0'


def track_analysis(path: Path) -> dict:
    key = hashlib.sha1(f"{path.resolve()}|{path.stat().st_size}|v1".encode()).hexdigest()[:16]
    cache = settings.cache_dir / "music" / f"{key}.json"
    if cache.exists():
        return json.loads(cache.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    data = an.analyse_music(path)
    cache.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    cache.write_text(json.dumps(data), encoding="utf-8")
    return data


class MusicSupervisor(Agent):
    key, title, icon, color = "music", "Music", "music", "#2ac3de"
    role = "picks the track and maps its tempo, beats, downbeats and energy so cuts can land on the music"

    def inputs(self, ctx: Ctx):
        t = chosen_track(ctx)
        return str(t[0]) if t else None

    def run(self, ctx: Ctx, rep: AgentRun) -> None:
        t = chosen_track(ctx)
        if not t:
            ctx.project.track = None
            rep.status = "skipped"
            rep.summary = "no music" + (" (this skill lets the footage's own sound carry it)"
                                        if not (ctx.skill.get("sound") or {}).get("music") else "")
            return
        path, name, credit = t
        d = track_analysis(path)
        tr = Track(name=name, path=str(path) if path.is_absolute() and not str(path).startswith(str(ctx.root)) else ctx.rel(path),
                   credit=credit, duration=d["duration"], tempo=d["tempo"], beats=d["beats"], downbeats=d["downbeats"],
                   energy=d["energy"], peaks=d["peaks"])
        ctx.project.track = tr
        e = np.array(tr.energy) if tr.energy else np.zeros(1)
        if len(e) >= 16:
            win = np.convolve(e, np.ones(16) / 16, "valid")
            k = int(np.argmax(win))
            loud = f"; loudest stretch {tr.beats[k]:.0f}–{tr.beats[min(k + 15, len(tr.beats) - 1)]:.0f}s"
        else:
            loud = ""
        self.decide(ctx, rep, f"track: {name} ({tr.duration:.0f}s) — {tr.tempo:.0f} BPM, {len(tr.beats)} beats, "
                              f"{len(tr.downbeats)} bars{loud}")
        self.decide(ctx, rep, f"credit: {credit}")
        ok = 50 <= tr.tempo <= 200 and len(tr.beats) > 8
        self.check(ctx, rep, "beat grid found", ok, f"{tr.tempo:.0f} BPM, {len(tr.beats)} beats"
                   + ("" if ok else " (no clear beat: cuts will follow the skill's own rhythm)"))
        rep.summary = f"{name} · {tr.tempo:.0f} BPM"

"""Filtergraphs shared by the Export agent (whole segments) and the agents' preview stills (single frames).

One segment = trim → speed → frame-rate → reframe (cover-scale + crop that can pan; perspective for smooth
zoom, punch-ins and gate weave) → colour (the clip's 3D LUT) → RGB effects (halation, glow, vignette...)
→ YUV effects (grain on luma, flicker) → fades and whip blur.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import math
from pathlib import Path

from .agents.base import Ctx, fps_arg
from .look import fx_rgb, fx_yuv
from .model import Clip, Seg


def _even_up(x: float) -> int:
    return int(math.ceil(x / 2) * 2)


def cover(sw: int, sh: int, W: int, H: int, z: float = 1.0) -> tuple[int, int]:
    s = max(W / sw, H / sh) * z
    return _even_up(sw * s), _even_up(sh * s)


def window(clip: Clip, W: int, H: int) -> float:
    """Fraction of the source width that is visible after a cover-crop to W x H (at zoom 1)."""
    return min(1.0, (W / H) / (clip.width / clip.height))


def video_graph(seg: Seg, clip: Clip, W: int, H: int, fps: float, lut: str | None, fx: dict,
                grain: float | None, motion: dict, whip_in: float = 0.0, whip_out: float = 0.0,
                still: bool = False) -> str:
    """Filtergraph from [0:v] to [v] for one clip segment."""
    L = max(seg.length, 1 / fps)
    chain = ["setpts=PTS-STARTPTS"]
    if abs(seg.speed - 1) > 1e-3:
        chain.append(f"setpts=PTS/{seg.speed:.5f}")
    if motion.get("cadence") and not still:
        chain.append(f"fps={int(motion['cadence'])}")
    if not still:
        chain.append(f"fps={fps_arg(fps)}")
    graded = f"format=gbrp,lut3d=file={lut}:interp=tetrahedral" if lut else "format=gbrp"
    parts: list[str] = []
    if seg.fill in ("blur", "fit"):
        parts.append(f"[0:v]{','.join(chain)},{graded},split[bgs][fgs]")
        if seg.fill == "blur":
            parts.append(f"[bgs]scale={W}:{H}:force_original_aspect_ratio=increase,crop={W}:{H},"
                         f"gblur=sigma={min(W, H) * 0.045:.1f},colorlevels=romax=0.8:gomax=0.8:bomax=0.8[bg]")
        else:
            parts.append(f"[bgs]scale={W}:{H},colorlevels=romax=0:gomax=0:bomax=0[bg]")
        parts.append(f"[fgs]scale={W}:{H}:force_original_aspect_ratio=decrease:flags=lanczos[fg]")
        parts.append("[bg][fg]overlay=(W-w)/2:(H-h)/2[in]")
    else:
        z0, z1 = max(seg.zoom0, 1.0), max(seg.zoom1, 1.0)
        zs = min(z0, z1)
        cw, ch = cover(clip.width, clip.height, W, H, zs)
        xa = min(max(seg.x0 * cw - W / 2, 0), cw - W)
        xb = min(max(seg.x1 * cw - W / 2, 0), cw - W)
        y = (ch - H) // 2
        if abs(xb - xa) < 1:
            crop = f"crop={W}:{H}:x={int(xa)}:y={y}"
        else:
            crop = f"crop={W}:{H}:x='{xa:.1f}+({xb - xa:.1f})*min(t/{L:.3f},1)':y={y}"
        steps = [*chain, f"scale={cw}:{ch}:flags=lanczos", crop]
        r0, r1 = z0 / zs, z1 / zs
        weave = float(motion.get("weave") or 0)
        if abs(r0 - 1) > 1e-3 or abs(r1 - 1) > 1e-3 or weave:
            tt = f"(in/{fps:.4f})"
            if seg.zoom_ease == "punch":
                r = f"({r1:.4f}+({r0 - r1:.4f})*pow(max(0,1-{tt}/0.28),2))"
            else:
                r = f"({r0:.4f}+({r1 - r0:.4f})*min({tt}/{L:.3f},1))"
            dx = dy = "0"
            if weave:
                a = weave * W / 1080
                r = f"(1.04*{r})"
                dx = f"({a:.2f}*(sin({tt}*5.3)+0.6*sin({tt}*11.1+1.3)))"
                dy = f"({a * 0.7:.2f}*(sin({tt}*4.1+0.7)+0.5*sin({tt}*9.7)))"
            hw, hh = f"(W/(2*{r}))", f"(H/(2*{r}))"
            cx, cy = f"(W/2+{dx})", f"(H/2+{dy})"
            steps.append(f"perspective=x0='{cx}-{hw}':y0='{cy}-{hh}':x1='{cx}+{hw}':y1='{cy}-{hh}':"
                         f"x2='{cx}-{hw}':y2='{cy}+{hh}':x3='{cx}+{hw}':y3='{cy}+{hh}':interpolation=linear:eval=frame")
        steps.append(graded)
        parts.append(f"[0:v]{','.join(steps)}[in]")
    rgb = fx_rgb(fx, W, H)
    parts.append(rgb)
    tail = ["scale=out_color_matrix=bt709:out_range=tv", "format=yuv420p", *fx_yuv(fx, grain, min(W, H))]
    if not still:
        if seg.fade_in > 0:
            tail.append(f"fade=t=in:st=0:d={seg.fade_in:.3f}")
        if seg.fade_out > 0:
            tail.append(f"fade=t=out:st={max(L - seg.fade_out, 0):.3f}:d={seg.fade_out:.3f}")
        radius = max(8, round(W * 0.05))
        if whip_in:
            tail.append(f"dblur=angle=0:radius={radius}:enable='lt(t,{whip_in:.3f})'")
        if whip_out:
            tail.append(f"dblur=angle=0:radius={radius}:enable='gt(t,{L - whip_out:.3f})'")
    parts.append(f"[out]{','.join(tail)}[v]")
    return ";".join(parts)


def card_graph(seg: Seg, W: int, H: int, fps: float) -> list[str]:
    return ["-f", "lavfi", "-i", f"color=c=black:s={W}x{H}:r={fps_arg(fps)}:d={seg.length:.4f}"]


def render_segment(ctx: Ctx, seg: Seg, clip: Clip | None, W: int, H: int, fps: float, lut: str | None,
                   fx: dict, grain: float | None, motion: dict, out: Path, whip_in: float = 0.0,
                   whip_out: float = 0.0) -> Path:
    enc = ["-c:v", "libx264", "-preset", "veryfast", "-crf", "14", "-pix_fmt", "yuv420p", "-color_primaries", "bt709",
           "-color_trc", "bt709", "-colorspace", "bt709", "-an", "-r", fps_arg(fps), "-t", f"{seg.length:.4f}"]
    if seg.kind == "card" or clip is None:
        ctx.ffmpeg(["-y", *card_graph(seg, W, H, fps), "-vf", "format=yuv420p", *enc, ctx.rel(out)])
        return out
    span = seg.src_out - seg.src_in
    graph = video_graph(seg, clip, W, H, fps, lut, fx, grain, motion, whip_in, whip_out)
    ctx.ffmpeg(["-y", "-ss", f"{seg.src_in:.4f}", "-t", f"{span + 0.1:.4f}", "-i", clip.master,
                "-filter_complex", graph, "-map", "[v]", *enc, ctx.rel(out)])
    return out


def still(ctx: Ctx, clip: Clip, t: float, out: Path, W: int, H: int, lut: str | None = None, fx: dict | None = None,
          grain: float | None = None, x: float | None = None, zoom: float = 1.0, ass: str | None = None,
          ass_t: float = 0.0, fill: str = "crop") -> Path:
    """One graded frame, framed exactly like the render (for the agents' previews and the look gallery)."""
    seg = Seg(id=0, clip=clip.id, src_in=t, src_out=t + 0.04, x0=x if x is not None else clip.subject,
              x1=x if x is not None else clip.subject, zoom0=zoom, zoom1=zoom, fill=fill)
    graph = video_graph(seg, clip, W, H, 25.0, lut, fx or {}, grain, {}, still=True)
    if ass:
        graph = graph[: graph.rfind("[v]")] + f",setpts=PTS-STARTPTS+{ass_t:.3f}/TB,subtitles={ass}:fontsdir=render/fonts[v]"
    out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    ctx.ffmpeg(["-y", "-ss", f"{max(t, 0):.3f}", "-i", clip.master, "-filter_complex", graph, "-map", "[v]",
                "-frames:v", "1", "-q:v", "3", ctx.rel(out)])
    return out

"""Colorist: corrects each clip (primary), matches clips to each other, applies the skill's look or the
reference's colour, and bakes it all into one 3D LUT per clip. Checks its own grade numerically."""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor

import numpy as np

from .. import analysis as an
from .. import look, skills
from ..model import AgentRun, Clip
from ..render import still
from .base import Agent, Ctx, frame_size, load_analysis


def clip_pixels(ctx: Ctx, clip: Clip) -> np.ndarray:
    return load_analysis(ctx, clip)["px"].astype(np.float32) / 255.0


def look_params(ctx: Ctx, skill: dict | None = None) -> tuple[dict, float, dict | None]:
    """(look, strength, reference match) for a skill under the current settings."""
    sk = skill or ctx.skill
    strength = float(ctx.settings.look) * float(sk.get("look_strength_scale", 1.0))
    strength *= float(ctx.hints.get("colorist", {}).get("boost_look", 1.0))
    ref = ctx.project.reference
    match = None
    if ref and ref.profile and ctx.settings.match_reference and skill is None:
        px = np.concatenate([look.apply_primary(clip_pixels(ctx, c), look.primary_params(clip_pixels(ctx, c)))
                             for c in ctx.project.clips])
        st = look.stats(px)
        s = min(1.0, float(ctx.settings.reference_strength) + float(ctx.hints.get("colorist", {}).get("boost_ref", 0)))
        match = {"src": st, "ref": ref.profile["look"], "strength": s}
    return sk.get("look") or {}, strength, match


def lut_for(ctx: Ctx, clip: Clip, lk: dict, strength: float, match: dict | None, tag: str) -> tuple[str, dict]:
    px = clip_pixels(ctx, clip)
    prim = look.primary_params(px)
    key = hashlib.sha1(json.dumps([prim, lk, strength, match], sort_keys=True, default=str).encode()).hexdigest()[:10]
    rel = f"looks/{clip.id}_{tag}_{key}.cube"
    if not ctx.abs(rel).exists():
        look.write_cube(ctx.abs(rel), look.bake(look.grade_fn(prim, lk, strength, match)), title=f"cutroom {tag} {clip.id}")
    return rel, prim


def grain_for(ctx: Ctx, fx: dict) -> float | None:
    if ctx.settings.grain is not None:
        return float(ctx.settings.grain)
    ref = ctx.project.reference
    if ref and ref.profile and ctx.settings.match_reference and ref.profile.get("noise") is not None:
        c = ctx.project.clips[0]
        full = an.frames(ctx.abs(c.master), 6 / max(c.duration, 1), an.analysis_size(c.width, c.height, 960))
        src = an.noise_level(full[:6])
        add = max(float(ref.profile["noise"]) ** 2 - src ** 2, 0) ** 0.5
        return round(float(np.clip(add * 1.73, 0, 22)), 1)
    return float(fx.get("grain", 0))


def look_previews(ctx: Ctx) -> dict[str, str]:
    """A still of the hero clip in every skill's look (and the reference's), for the skill gallery."""
    if not ctx.project.clips:
        return {}
    hero = ctx.project.clips[0]
    out: dict[str, str] = {}
    jobs = []
    all_sk = skills.all_skills()
    for name, sk in all_sk.items():
        lk = sk.get("look") or {}
        jobs.append((name, lk, 1.0, None, sk.get("fx") or {}))
    ref = ctx.project.reference
    if ref and ref.profile:
        px = np.concatenate([look.apply_primary(clip_pixels(ctx, c), look.primary_params(clip_pixels(ctx, c)))
                             for c in ctx.project.clips])
        jobs.append(("reference", {}, 0.0, {"src": look.stats(px), "ref": ref.profile["look"], "strength": 0.85},
                     {"vignette": ref.profile.get("vignette", 0)}))
    jobs.append(("original", None, 0.0, None, {}))

    def one(job):
        name, lk, s, match, fx = job
        lut = None if lk is None else lut_for(ctx, hero, lk, s, match, f"pv-{name}")[0]
        path = ctx.root / "stills" / f"look_{name}.jpg"
        still(ctx, hero, hero.best_t, path, 400, 500, lut=lut, fx={k: v for k, v in fx.items() if k != "letterbox"},
              grain=(fx.get("grain", 0) or 0) * 0.6)
        return name, f"stills/look_{name}.jpg"

    with ThreadPoolExecutor(3) as ex:
        for name, rel in ex.map(one, jobs):
            out[name] = rel
    return out


class Colorist(Agent):
    key, title, icon, color = "colorist", "Colorist", "palette", "#ff9e64"
    role = "corrects each clip, matches them to each other, then grades the look (or the reference's colour) into a LUT"
    needs = ("intake", "reference")

    def inputs(self, ctx: Ctx):
        s = ctx.settings
        ref = ctx.project.reference
        return [ctx.skill.get("look"), ctx.skill.get("fx"), ctx.skill.get("look_strength_scale"), s.look, s.grain,
                s.match_reference, s.reference_strength, ref.profile.get("look") if ref and ref.profile else None,
                [c.analysis for c in ctx.project.clips], ctx.hints.get("colorist")]

    def run(self, ctx: Ctx, rep: AgentRun) -> None:
        p = ctx.project
        lk, strength, match = look_params(ctx)
        luts, prims, graded = {}, {}, {}
        before_mid = []
        for c in p.clips:
            rel, prim = lut_for(ctx, c, lk, strength, match, ctx.skill.get("name", "look"))
            luts[c.id], prims[c.id] = rel, prim
            m = prim["measured"]
            if prim["black"] > 0 or prim["white"] < 1:
                self.decide(ctx, rep, f"{c.id}: flat footage (luma {m['p1']:.2f}–{m['p99']:.2f}, saturation {m['sat']:.2f}) "
                                      f"→ stretched to full range, mid-tones γ{prim['gamma']:.2f}, saturation ×{prim['sat']:.2f}")
            elif abs(prim["gamma"] - 1) > 0.01 or prim["sat"] > 1:
                self.decide(ctx, rep, f"{c.id}: exposure re-centred (γ{prim['gamma']:.2f}), saturation ×{prim['sat']:.2f}")
            else:
                self.decide(ctx, rep, f"{c.id}: well exposed, balance only (cast {m['cast']:.2f})")
            px = clip_pixels(ctx, c)
            before_mid.append(float(np.median(look.luma(px))))
            graded[c.id] = look.stats(look.grade_fn(prim, lk, strength, match)(px))
        if len(p.clips) > 1:
            after_mid = [graded[c.id]["luma"][2] for c in p.clips]
            self.decide(ctx, rep, f"shot matching: mid-grey spread across clips {np.ptp(before_mid):.2f} → {np.ptp(after_mid):.2f}")
        if match:
            self.decide(ctx, rep, f"matching the reference's colour at {match['strength']:.0%} (CIELAB mean + spread transfer); "
                                  f"skill look reduced to {strength:.0%}")
        else:
            self.decide(ctx, rep, f"{ctx.skill.get('label', 'skill')} look at {strength:.0%}: "
                                  + ", ".join(f"{k} {v}" for k, v in lk.items() if not isinstance(v, list)))
        fx = dict(ctx.skill.get("fx") or {})
        grain = grain_for(ctx, fx)
        if match and ctx.project.reference.profile.get("vignette") is not None:
            fx["vignette"] = ctx.project.reference.profile["vignette"]
        self.decide(ctx, rep, "texture: " + ", ".join([f"grain {grain:g}"] + [f"{k} {v}" for k, v in fx.items() if k != "grain"]))
        for c in p.clips:
            g = graded[c.id]
            self.check(ctx, rep, f"{c.id} no clipping", g["clip_hi"] < 0.03 and g["clip_lo"] < 0.04,
                       f"{g['clip_hi']:.1%} blown, {g['clip_lo']:.1%} crushed")
            self.check(ctx, rep, f"{c.id} exposure", 0.2 <= g["luma"][2] <= 0.66, f"mid-grey {g['luma'][2]:.2f}")
        if match:
            ref_lab = ctx.project.reference.profile["look"]["lab_mean"]
            de = float(np.mean([look.delta_e(graded[c.id]["lab_mean"], ref_lab) for c in p.clips]))
            self.check(ctx, rep, "matches the reference", de < 8, f"average colour ΔE {de:.1f} from the reference (under 8 passes)",
                       hint={"boost_ref": 0.15})
        p.look = {"luts": luts, "primary": prims, "fx": fx, "grain": grain, "strength": strength, "graded": graded,
                  "match": bool(match)}
        hero = p.clips[0]
        W, H = frame_size(ctx.settings)
        scale = 540 / max(W, H)
        sw, sh = round(W * scale / 2) * 2, round(H * scale / 2) * 2

input.content:
"""Cutter: plans the rhythm and picks a moment of footage for every slot.

Rhythm: holds and bursts of quick cuts from the skill (or the reference's measured rhythm), scaled by the
pacing slider. With music, every cut is placed on a beat (bursts on beats or half beats, held back until the
music is loud enough), and the track is entered on a downbeat chosen so its loudest stretch carries the edit.

Moments: every 0.1 s of footage gets an interest score (sharpness, action, exposure, a clear subject). A
dynamic program picks, for every slot, the window with the best score for its role (hook, hold, burst,
outro) while keeping story order and a gap between moments, never crossing a camera cut. Energy-driven
skills pick greedily instead (best moments to the loudest slots).
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np

from ..model import AgentRun, Seg
from .base import Agent, Ctx, load_analysis, retime, usable_ranges

DT = 0.1
NEG = -1e9


class Footage:
    """All clips on one 0.1 s grid, with a dead sample between clips so no window can span two clips."""

    def __init__(self, ctx: Ctx):
        cols = {k: [] for k in ("clip", "t", "sharp", "motion", "bright", "hi", "lo", "conf", "usable", "sx")}
        self.clips = ctx.project.clips
        for ci, c in enumerate(self.clips):
            d = load_analysis(ctx, c)
            grid = np.arange(0, max(c.duration - 1e-6, DT), DT)
            ts = d["t"] if len(d["t"]) else np.zeros(1)

            def at(k: str) -> np.ndarray:
                return np.interp(grid, ts, d[k]) if len(d[k]) == len(ts) and len(ts) > 1 else np.full(len(grid), float(d[k].mean() if len(d[k]) else 0))

            use = np.zeros(len(grid), bool)
            for a, b in usable_ranges(c):
                use |= (grid >= a) & (grid <= b)
            for k, v in (("sharp", at("sharp")), ("motion", at("motion")), ("bright", at("bright")), ("hi", at("hi")),
                         ("lo", at("lo")), ("conf", at("conf")), ("sx", at("sx"))):
                cols[k].append(v)
            cols["clip"].append(np.full(len(grid), ci))
            cols["t"].append(grid)
            cols["usable"].append(use)
            for k in cols:  # separator
                cols[k].append(np.array([False if k == "usable" else (ci if k == "clip" else 0.0)]))
        for k, v in cols.items():
            setattr(self, k, np.concatenate(v))
        self.N = len(self.t)
        live = self.usable
        p90s = np.percentile(self.sharp[live], 90) if live.any() else 1.0
        p75m = np.percentile(self.motion[live], 75) if live.any() else 1.0
        self.sharp_n = np.clip(self.sharp / (p90s + 1e-6), 0, 1)
        self.mot_n = self.motion / (p75m + 1e-6)
        self.action = np.clip(self.mot_n, 0, 1.5) / 1.5
        expo = 1 - np.clip(np.abs(self.bright - 0.45) * 1.6, 0, 1) - np.clip((self.hi + self.lo) * 3, 0, 1)
        c1 = np.clip(self.conf - 1, 0, None)
        conf_n = np.clip(c1 / (np.percentile(c1[live], 90) + 1e-6 if live.any() else 1), 0, 1)
        self.interest = 0.42 * self.sharp_n + 0.22 * self.action + 0.21 * expo + 0.15 * conf_n
        shaky = (self.mot_n > 3.0) & (self.sharp_n < 0.3)
        self.usable = self.usable & (self.bright > 0.025) & (self.bright < 0.97) & (self.hi < 0.3) & ~shaky
        self.usable_s = float(self.usable.sum() * DT)

    def _win(self, arr: np.ndarray, L: int) -> np.ndarray:
        c = np.concatenate([[0.0], np.cumsum(arr, dtype=np.float64)])
        out = np.full(self.N, np.nan)
        if L <= self.N:
            out[: self.N - L + 1] = (c[L:] - c[:-L]) / L
        return out

    def scores(self, L: int, role: str, avoid: np.ndarray | None = None) -> np.ndarray:
        ok = self._win(self.usable.astype(np.float64), L) > 0.999
        if avoid is not None:
            ok &= ~(self._win(avoid.astype(np.float64), L) > 0)
        mi, ma = self._win(self.interest, L), self._win(self.action, L)
        if role == "hook":
            s = 0.55 * mi + 0.45 * ma
        elif role == "burst":
            s = 0.4 * mi + 0.6 * ma
        elif role == "outro":
            s = mi + 0.2 * (1 - ma)
        elif role == "hold":
            sd = np.sqrt(np.clip(self._win(self.action ** 2, L) - ma ** 2, 0, None))
            s = mi - 0.25 * sd
        else:
            s = mi
        return np.where(ok & np.isfinite(s), s, NEG)


def _running_argmax(a: np.ndarray) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    m = np.maximum.accumulate(a)
    idx = np.maximum.accumulate(np.where(a >= m, np.arange(len(a)), 0))
    return m, idx


def assign_story(fo: Footage, slots: list[tuple[float, str]], gap_s: float, avoid=None) -> list[tuple[int, int]] | None:
    """Dynamic program: one window per slot, in story order, at least gap_s apart. Returns [(start, L)]."""
    K, G = len(slots), int(round(gap_s / DT))
    Ls = [max(1, int(np.ceil(d / DT - 1e-6))) for d, _ in slots]
    dp, back = [], []
    prev_m = prev_i = None
    for k, ((d, role), L) in enumerate(zip(slots, Ls)):
        sc = fo.scores(L, role, avoid)
        if k == 0:
            cur = sc
            back.append(None)
        else:
            shift = Ls[k - 1] + G
            cand = np.full(fo.N, NEG * 4)
            src = np.arange(fo.N) - shift
            ok = src >= 0
            cand[ok] = prev_m[src[ok]]
            cur = np.where(sc > NEG / 2, sc + cand, NEG * 4)
            pi = np.zeros(fo.N, np.int64)
            pi[ok] = prev_i[src[ok]]
            back.append(pi)
        dp.append(cur)
        prev_m, prev_i = _running_argmax(cur)
    end = int(np.argmax(dp[-1]))
    if dp[-1][end] < NEG / 2:
        return None
    picks = [end]
    for k in range(K - 1, 0, -1):
        picks.append(int(back[k][picks[-1]]))
    picks.reverse()
    return list(zip(picks, Ls))


def assign_energy(fo: Footage, slots: list[tuple[float, str]], gap_s: float, energy: list[float],
                  avoid=None) -> list[tuple[int, int]] | None:
    """Greedy: the hook first, then the loudest slots get the most active moments; no overlaps."""
    G = int(round(gap_s / DT))
    Ls = [max(1, int(np.ceil(d / DT - 1e-6))) for d, _ in slots]
    order = sorted(range(len(slots)), key=lambda k: (slots[k][1] != "hook", -(energy[k] if k < len(energy) else 0), k))
    taken = np.zeros(fo.N, bool) if avoid is None else avoid.copy()
    out: dict[int, tuple[int, int]] = {}
    for k in order:
        sc = fo.scores(Ls[k], slots[k][1], taken)
        i = int(np.argmax(sc))
        if sc[i] < NEG / 2:
            return None
        out[k] = (i, Ls[k])
        taken[max(0, i - G): i + Ls[k] + G] = True
    return [out[k] for k in range(len(slots))]


def plan_free(T: float, shot: float, P: dict) -> list[tuple[float, str]]:
    mult = [1.0, 1.18, 0.86, 1.08, 0.94, 1.22, 0.9]
    every, n_b, b_shot = int(P.get("burst_every") or 0), int(P.get("burst_len") or 4), float(P.get("burst_shot") or 0.5)
    outro = shot * float(P.get("outro", 1.4))
    out: list[tuple[float, str]] = []
    t, since, j = 0.0, 0, 0
    while True:
        rem = T - t
        if rem <= outro * 1.25:
            break
        if every and since >= every and rem - n_b * b_shot > outro + shot * 0.5:
            out += [(b_shot, "burst")] * n_b
            t += n_b * b_shot
            since = 0
            continue
        d = shot * mult[j % len(mult)]
        j += 1
        if rem - d < outro * 0.8:
            break
        out.append((d, "hook" if not out else "hold"))
        t += d
        since += 1
    out.append((max(T - t, min(shot * 0.6, T)), "outro" if out else "hook"))
    return out


def plan_beats(start: float, T: float, shot: float, P: dict, beats: list[float],
               energy_at) -> list[tuple[float, float, str]]:
    """Slots on the beat grid (timeline seconds). Bursts use beats or half beats and wait for loud music."""
    b = np.array([x for x in beats if x >= -1e-6])
    if len(b) < 4:
        return []
    period = float(np.median(np.diff(b)))
    sub = np.sort(np.concatenate([b, (b[:-1] + b[1:]) / 2]))  # half-beat grid
    hold_b = min((1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8), key=lambda n: abs(np.log(n * period / shot)))
    burst_b = float(P.get("burst_beats") or 1)
    while burst_b * period < 0.22:
        burst_b *= 2
    hold_u, burst_u = int(hold_b * 2), max(1, int(round(burst_b * 2)))
    outro_u = max(hold_u, int(round(hold_u * float(P.get("outro", 1.4)) / 2)) * 2)
    every, n_b = int(P.get("burst_every") or 0), int(P.get("burst_len") or 4)
    cur = int(np.argmin(np.abs(sub - start)))
    end = int(np.searchsorted(sub, start + T + 1e-3)) - 1
    slots: list[tuple[float, float, str]] = []
    since = 0
    while True:
        rem = end - cur
        if rem <= outro_u * 1.25:
            break
        if (every and since >= every and rem - n_b * burst_u > outro_u + hold_u // 2
                and energy_at(sub[cur], sub[min(cur + n_b * burst_u, end)]) >= 0.45):
            for _ in range(n_b):
                slots.append((float(sub[cur]), float(sub[cur + burst_u]), "burst"))
                cur += burst_u
            since = 0
            continue
        if rem - hold_u < outro_u * 0.8:
            break
        slots.append((float(sub[cur]), float(sub[cur + hold_u]), "hook" if not slots else "hold"))
        cur += hold_u
        since += 1
    if end > cur:
        slots.append((float(sub[cur]), float(sub[end]), "outro" if slots else "hook"))
    return slots


def choose_music_in(track, T: float) -> float:
    """Enter the track on a downbeat where the stretch under the edit is loud and starts with presence."""
    beats, e = np.array(track.beats), np.array(track.energy or [0.5] * len(track.beats))
    if not len(beats):
        return 0.0
    best, best_s = float(track.downbeats[0]) if track.downbeats else float(beats[0]), -1e9
    for d in track.downbeats or [beats[0]]:
        if d + T > track.duration - 0.3:
            break
        sel = (beats >= d) & (beats < d + T)
        if not sel.any():
            continue
        first = e[np.nonzero(sel)[0][:4]]
        s = float(e[sel].mean()) + 0.6 * float(first.mean()) - 0.15 * d / max(track.duration, 1)
        if s > best_s:
            best, best_s = float(d), s
    return round(best, 3)


def speech_pieces(ctx: Ctx, T: float | None) -> list[tuple[str, float, float]]:
    """Talking footage: keep every stretch of sound, cut every pause (with a little air either side)."""
    out = []
    for c in ctx.project.clips:
        ranges = [(max(s - 0.08, 0.0), min(e + 0.12, c.duration)) for s, e in c.sound]
        merged: list[list[float]] = []
        for s, e in ranges:
            if merged and s - merged[-1][1] < 0.25:
                merged[-1][1] = e
            else:
                merged.append([s, e])
        out += [(c.id, round(s, 3), round(e, 3)) for s, e in merged if e - s >= 0.4]
    if T:
        kept, total = [], 0.0
        for piece in out:
            if total >= T:
                break
            kept.append(piece)
            total += piece[2] - piece[1]
        out = kept
    return out


class Cutter(Agent):
    key, title, icon, color = "cutter", "Cutter", "scissors", "#f7768e"
    role = "plans the rhythm (on the beat when there is music) and picks the best moment for every slot, in story order"
    needs = ("intake", "music", "reference")

    def inputs(self, ctx: Ctx):
        s, t = ctx.settings, ctx.project.track
        return [ctx.skill.get("pace"), ctx.skill.get("name"), ctx.skill.get("text", {}).get("title", {}).get("card"),
                ctx.skill.get("text", {}).get("end", {}).get("card"), s.length, s.pacing, s.beat_sync,
                bool(s.title), bool(s.end_card), [(c.id, c.analysis, c.duration) for c in ctx.project.clips],
                (t.path, t.tempo, len(t.beats)) if t else None, ctx.hints.get("cutter")]

    def run(self, ctx: Ctx, rep: AgentRun) -> None:
        p, s, sk = ctx.project, ctx.settings, ctx.skill
        P = dict(sk.get("pace") or {})
        hint = ctx.hints.get("cutter", {})
        shot = float(P.get("shot", 2.5)) / max(s.pacing, 0.3)
        gap = float(P.get("gap", 0.35))
        fo = Footage(ctx)
        text = sk.get("text") or {}
        title_card = bool(s.title) and bool(text.get("title", {}).get("card"))
        end_card = bool(s.end_card) and bool(text.get("end", {}).get("card"))
        card_d = float(text.get("title", {}).get("dur", 2.4)) if title_card else 0.0
        end_d = float(text.get("end", {}).get("dur", 2.2)) if end_card else 0.0
        self.decide(ctx, rep, f"{fo.usable_s:.1f}s of usable footage (after removing camera-cut edges, black, blown "
                              f"or blurred stretches) across {len(p.clips)} clip{'s' if len(p.clips) > 1 else ''}")

        # talking-head skills: keep the sound, cut the pauses
        if P.get("jumpcut") and any(c.sound for c in p.clips):
            pieces = speech_pieces(ctx, s.length - card_d - end_d if s.length else None)
            tl = [Seg(id=0, kind="card", card=card_d, role="card")] if title_card else []
            for cid, a, b in pieces:
                tl.append(Seg(id=len(tl), clip=cid, src_in=a, src_out=b, role="jump",
                              why=f"sound {a:.1f}–{b:.1f}s, pause before it removed"))
            if end_card:
                tl.append(Seg(id=len(tl), kind="card", card=end_d, role="card"))
            removed = sum(c.duration for c in p.clips) - sum(b - a for _, a, b in pieces)
            self.decide(ctx, rep, f"talking footage: kept {len(pieces)} stretches of speech, removed {removed:.1f}s of pauses")
            self._finish(ctx, rep, tl, [], None)
            return

        track = p.track if (p.track and s.beat_sync and len(p.track.beats) > 8) else None
        if s.length:
            T_content = max(2.0, float(s.length) - card_d - end_d)
        else:
            base = fo.usable_s * float(P.get("auto_ratio", 0.75))
            k_est = base / max(shot, 0.3)
            T_content = float(min(P.get("max_auto", 45), max(4.0, base - gap * k_est)))
        T_content *= float(hint.get("length_scale", 1.0))
        if track:
            T_content = min(T_content, track.duration - card_d - end_d - 1.0)

        avoid = None
        if hint.get("avoid"):
            avoid = np.zeros(fo.N, bool)
            for cid, a, b in hint["avoid"]:
                ci = next(i for i, c in enumerate(p.clips) if c.id == cid)
                avoid |= (fo.clip == ci) & (fo.t >= a - 0.1) & (fo.t <= b + 0.1)

        energy_order = P.get("order") == "energy"
        picks = slots_t = None
        music_in = 0.0
        beat_t: list[float] = []
        for attempt in range(8):
            if track:
                music_in = choose_music_in(track, card_d + T_content + end_d)
                beat_t = [round(b - music_in, 4) for b in track.beats if b >= music_in - 1e-6]
                period = float(np.median(np.diff(beat_t))) if len(beat_t) > 2 else 0.5
                lead = 0.0
                if title_card:
                    n = max(2, int(round(card_d / period / 2)) * 2)
                    lead = beat_t[min(n, len(beat_t) - 1)]
                eb = np.array(track.energy)

                def energy_at(a: float, b: float) -> float:
                    sel = [i for i, x in enumerate(beat_t) if a - 1e-6 <= x < b and i < len(eb)]
                    sel = [i + len(track.beats) - len(beat_t) for i in sel]
                    return float(eb[sel].mean()) if sel else 0.5

                timed = plan_beats(lead, T_content, shot, P, beat_t, energy_at)
                slots = [(b - a, r) for a, b, r in timed]
                card_d = lead
            else:
                slots = plan_free(T_content, shot, P)
                timed = []
            if not slots:
                track = None
                continue
            energies = []
            if track and timed:
                energies = [energy_at(a, b) for a, b, _ in timed]
            picks = (assign_energy(fo, slots, gap, energies, avoid) if energy_order
                     else assign_story(fo, slots, gap, avoid))
            if picks:
                slots_t = slots
                break
            if gap > 0.05:
                gap = 0.0
                self.decide(ctx, rep, "not enough distinct footage for gaps between moments: allowing back-to-back "
                                      "moments (they become jump cuts)")
            else:
                T_content *= 0.88
                self.decide(ctx, rep, f"the footage can't fill that many slots: shortening the cut to {T_content:.1f}s")
        if not picks:
            raise RuntimeError("could not fit the edit into the footage (too little usable footage)")

        tl: list[Seg] = []
        if title_card:
            tl.append(Seg(id=0, kind="card", card=round(card_d, 4), role="card", why="title card"))
        for (d, role), (i, L) in zip(slots_t, picks):
            ci = int(fo.clip[i])
            c = p.clips[ci]
            a = float(fo.t[i])
            mi, ma = float(fo.interest[i:i + L].mean()), float(fo.action[i:i + L].mean())
            tl.append(Seg(id=len(tl), clip=c.id, src_in=round(a, 4), src_out=round(a + d, 4), role=role,
                          score=round(mi, 3), x0=float(fo.sx[i:i + L].mean()), x1=float(fo.sx[i:i + L].mean()),
                          why=f"{role}: interest {mi:.2f}, action {ma:.2f}, sharp {float(fo.sharp_n[i:i + L].mean()):.2f}"))
        if end_card:
            tl.append(Seg(id=len(tl), kind="card", card=end_d, role="card", why="end card"))
        if track:
            p.audio.music_in = music_in
            self.decide(ctx, rep, f"music enters on the downbeat at {music_in:.2f}s; every cut sits on a beat "
                                  f"({p.track.tempo:.0f} BPM)")
        n_b = sum(1 for _, r in slots_t if r == "burst")
        holds = [d for d, r in slots_t if r != "burst"]
        self.decide(ctx, rep, f"rhythm: {len(holds)} holds (avg {np.mean(holds):.1f}s)"
                              + (f" + {n_b} burst cuts" if n_b else "") + f", target shot {shot:.1f}s"
                              + (" · moments ranked by energy" if energy_order else " · story order kept"))
        self._finish(ctx, rep, tl, beat_t, track)

    def _finish(self, ctx: Ctx, rep: AgentRun, tl: list[Seg], beat_t: list[float], track) -> None:
        p = ctx.project
        for i, sg in enumerate(tl):
            sg.id = i
        retime(tl)
        p.timeline = tl
        # self-checks
        crossing = []
        for sg in tl:
            if sg.kind != "clip":
                continue
            c = p.clip(sg.clip)
            if any(sg.src_in < cut < sg.src_out for cut in c.cuts):
                crossing.append(sg.id)
        self.check(ctx, rep, "no camera cut inside a segment", not crossing,
                   "none" if not crossing else f"segments {crossing}")
        clip_segs = [sg for sg in tl if sg.kind == "clip"]
        if track and beat_t:
            bt = np.array(beat_t)
            sub = np.sort(np.concatenate([bt, (bt[:-1] + bt[1:]) / 2]))
            on = sum(1 for sg in clip_segs if np.min(np.abs(sub - sg.start)) < 0.02)
            self.check(ctx, rep, "cuts on the beat", on >= 0.9 * len(clip_segs), f"{on}/{len(clip_segs)} cuts on a beat")
        rep.summary = f"{len(clip_segs)} cuts · {p.duration:.1f}s"

"""Reframer: fits every shot to the chosen format, keeping the subject in frame.

A narrower format (e.g. 9:16 from 16:9) crops a window that follows the subject: a static frame when the
subject holds still, a slow pan when it moves. Footage narrower than the format (vertical phone video in a
16:9 edit) is placed over a blurred fill of itself instead of being cropped.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np

from ..model import AgentRun
from ..render import still, window
from .base import Agent, Ctx, frame_size, load_analysis


class Reframer(Agent):
    key, title, icon, color = "reframer", "Reframer", "crop", "#9ece6a"
    role = "fits every shot to your format and keeps the subject in frame (static or a slow pan that follows it)"
    needs = ("cutter",)

    def inputs(self, ctx: Ctx):
        return [ctx.settings.aspect, [(s.clip, s.src_in, s.src_out) for s in ctx.project.timeline],
                [c.analysis for c in ctx.project.clips], ctx.hints.get("reframer")]

    def run(self, ctx: Ctx, rep: AgentRun) -> None:
        p = ctx.project
        W, H = frame_size(ctx.settings)
        cache: dict[str, dict] = {}
        n_static = n_pan = n_fill = n_full = 0
        inside_all: list[float] = []
        for sg in p.timeline:
            if sg.kind != "clip":
                continue
            c = p.clip(sg.clip)
            if (W / H) > (c.width / c.height) * 1.12:
                sg.fill, sg.x0, sg.x1 = "blur", 0.5, 0.5
                n_fill += 1
                continue
            sg.fill = "crop"
            win = window(c, W, H)
            if win > 0.97:
                sg.x0 = sg.x1 = 0.5
                n_full += 1
                continue
            d = cache.setdefault(c.id, load_analysis(ctx, c))
            ts, sx = d["t"], d["sx"]
            sel = (ts >= sg.src_in) & (ts <= sg.src_out)
            xs = sx[sel] if sel.any() else sx[[int(np.argmin(np.abs(ts - (sg.src_in + sg.src_out) / 2)))]]
            k = max(1, int(len(xs) * 0.4))
            a, b, mid = float(np.median(xs[:k])), float(np.median(xs[-k:])), float(np.median(xs))
            lo, hi = win / 2, 1 - win / 2

            def score(x0: float, x1: float) -> float:
                path = np.linspace(x0, x1, len(xs))
                return float(np.mean(np.abs(xs - path) <= 0.35 * win))

            static = (min(max(mid, lo), hi),) * 2
            pan = (min(max(a, lo), hi), min(max(b, lo), hi))
            choice = static
            if abs(b - a) >= win * 0.15 or ctx.hints.get("reframer", {}).get("pan"):
                if score(*pan) > score(*static) + 0.05:
                    choice = pan
            sg.x0, sg.x1 = round(choice[0], 4), round(choice[1], 4)
            inside = score(*choice)
            inside_all.append(inside)
            if choice is pan and abs(pan[1] - pan[0]) > 0.005:
                n_pan += 1
            else:
                n_static += 1
        clip_n = n_static + n_pan
        if clip_n:
            c0 = p.clips[0]
            self.decide(ctx, rep, f"{ctx.settings.aspect} from {c0.width}x{c0.height}: a {window(c0, W, H):.0%}-wide window "
                                  f"follows the subject — {n_static} static, {n_pan} slow pan{'s' if n_pan != 1 else ''}")
        if n_fill:
            self.decide(ctx, rep, f"{n_fill} shot(s) narrower than the frame: placed over a blurred fill instead of cropping")
        if n_full:
            self.decide(ctx, rep, f"{n_full} shot(s) already match the format: no reframing")
        if inside_all:
            worst = min(inside_all)
            self.check(ctx, rep, "subject in frame", worst >= 0.75,
                       f"subject inside the middle 70% of the frame for {np.mean(inside_all):.0%} of the time (worst shot {worst:.0%})",
                       hint={"pan": True})
        first = next((s for s in p.timeline if s.kind == "clip"), None)
        if first:
            c = p.clip(first.clip)
            scale = 540 / max(W, H)
            sw, sh = round(W * scale / 2) * 2, round(H * scale / 2) * 2
            still(ctx, c, (first.src_in + first.src_out) / 2, ctx.root / "stills" / "reframer.jpg", sw, sh,
                  x=(first.x0 + first.x1) / 2, fill=first.fill)
            rep.preview = "stills/reframer.jpg"
        rep.summary = f"{W}x{H} · {n_static} static · {n_pan} pan" + (f" · {n_fill} fill" if n_fill else "")

input.content:
"""Typographer: sets the title, stamp and story lines in the skill's type and places them on the cuts.

Every line gets enough time to be read (0.75 s + 0.3 s a word), changes on a cut when one is near, stays in
the safe area, and is checked against what is behind it: on a bright background it gets a soft shade.
Rendered with libass (ASS subtitles) from the bundled fonts, so it is exact and fast.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import shutil

import numpy as np

from ...config import settings as app_settings
from .. import look
from ..model import AgentRun, Text
from ..render import still
from .base import Agent, Ctx, frame_size, load_analysis, out_fps


def _cased(text: str, case: str) -> str:
    return text.lower() if case == "lower" else text.upper() if case == "upper" else text


def _t(t: float) -> str:
    t = max(t, 0)
    return f"{int(t // 3600)}:{int(t % 3600 // 60):02d}:{t % 60:05.2f}"


def _bgr(hex6: str) -> str:
    h = hex6.strip("#").upper()
    return f"&H{h[4:6]}{h[2:4]}{h[0:2]}&"


def _clean(text: str) -> str:
    return text.replace("\\", "/").replace("{", "(").replace("}", ")").replace("\n", " ").strip()


def ass_document(W: int, H: int, texts: list[Text]) -> str:
    head = (f"[Script Info]\nScriptType: v4.00+\nPlayResX: {W}\nPlayResY: {H}\nWrapStyle: 0\n"
            "ScaledBorderAndShadow: yes\nYCbCr Matrix: TV.709\n\n[V4+ Styles]\n"
            "Format: Name, Fontname, Fontsize, PrimaryColour, SecondaryColour, OutlineColour, BackColour, Bold, Italic, "
            "Underline, StrikeOut, ScaleX, ScaleY, Spacing, Angle, BorderStyle, Outline, Shadow, Alignment, MarginL, "
            "MarginR, MarginV, Encoding\n"
            f"Style: Base,Montserrat SemiBold,48,&H00FFFFFF,&H00FFFFFF,&H00000000,&H00000000,0,0,0,0,100,100,0,0,1,0,0,5,"
            f"{int(W * 0.08)},{int(W * 0.08)},0,1\n\n[Events]\n"
            "Format: Layer, Start, End, Style, Name, MarginL, MarginR, MarginV, Effect, Text\n")
    ev = []
    for tx in texts:
        st = tx.style
        size, x, y = st["px"], st["x_px"], st["y_px"]
        an = {"left": 4, "right": 6}.get(st.get("align", "center"), 5)
        fi, fo = st.get("fade_in", 180), st.get("fade_out", 200)
        base = f"\\an{an}\\fn{st['font']}\\fs{size}\\fsp{st.get('spacing', 0)}\\bord0\\shad0\\fad({fi},{fo})"
        pop = "\\fscx116\\fscy116\\t(0,140,\\fscx100\\fscy100)" if tx.kind == "word" else ""
        txt = _clean(tx.text)
        a, b = _t(tx.start), _t(tx.end)
        if st.get("shade"):
            hh = int(size * 2.6)
            ev.append(f"Dialogue: 0,{a},{b},Base,,0,0,0,,{{\\an7\\pos(0,{y - hh // 2})\\p1\\1c&H000000&\\1a&H88&"
                      f"\\bord0\\shad0\\blur{int(size * 0.9)}\\fad({fi},{fo})}}m 0 0 l {W} 0 {W} {hh} 0 {hh}{{\\p0}}")
        sh = float(st.get("shadow", 0.5))
        if sh > 0:
            alpha = 255 - int(255 * min(sh, 1) * 0.6)
            off = max(1, int(size * 0.045))
            ev.append(f"Dialogue: 1,{a},{b},Base,,0,0,0,,{{{base}{pop}\\pos({x + off},{y + off})\\1c&H000000&"
                      f"\\1a&H{alpha:02X}&\\blur{max(2, int(size * 0.12))}}}{txt}")
        if st.get("glow"):
            ev.append(f"Dialogue: 1,{a},{b},Base,,0,0,0,,{{{base}\\pos({x},{y})\\1a&HFF&\\bord{max(2, int(size * 0.1))}"
                      f"\\3c{_bgr(st['color'])}\\3a&H90&\\blur{max(3, int(size * 0.2))}}}{txt}")
        ev.append(f"Dialogue: 2,{a},{b},Base,,0,0,0,,{{{base}{pop}\\pos({x},{y})\\1c{_bgr(st['color'])}}}{txt}")
    return head + "\n".join(ev) + "\n"


def install_fonts(ctx: Ctx) -> None:
    dst = ctx.root / "render" / "fonts"
    dst.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    for f in app_settings.fonts_dir.glob("*.ttf"):
        if not (dst / f.name).exists():
            shutil.copyfile(f, dst / f.name)


class Typographer(Agent):
    key, title, icon, color = "typographer", "Typographer", "type", "#c0caf5"
    role = "sets your title, stamp and story lines in the skill's type, on the cuts, and checks each can be read"
    needs = ("motion", "colorist")

    def inputs(self, ctx: Ctx):
        s = ctx.settings
        return [s.title, s.stamp, s.story, s.end_card, s.lowercase, s.aspect, s.resolution, ctx.skill.get("text"),
                [(g.kind, g.start, g.length, g.role, g.clip, g.src_in, g.speed, g.x0, g.fill) for g in ctx.project.timeline],
                ctx.project.look.get("luts"), ctx.hints.get("typographer")]

    def run(self, ctx: Ctx, rep: AgentRun) -> None:
        p, s = ctx.project, ctx.settings
        T = ctx.skill.get("text") or {}
        W, H = frame_size(s)
        short, portrait = min(W, H), H > W
        case = "lower" if s.lowercase is True else ("as_typed" if s.lowercase is False else T.get("case", "as_typed"))
        tl = p.timeline
        clips = [g for g in tl if g.kind == "clip"]
        texts: list[Text] = []
        if not clips:
            raise RuntimeError("nothing to put text on: the timeline is empty")
        c_start, c_end = clips[0].start, clips[-1].start + clips[-1].length
        cuts = [g.start for g in clips]

        def style(kind: str) -> dict:
            st = dict(T.get(kind) or T.get("story") or {})
            st["px"] = int(round(float(st.get("size", 0.05)) * short))
            st["x_px"] = int(round(float(st.get("x", 0.5)) * W))
            y = float(st.get("y" if portrait else "y_land", st.get("y", 0.6)))
            if portrait and kind not in ("title", "end"):
                y = min(max(y, 0.12), 0.84)  # platform safe area (top bar, caption and buttons at the bottom)
            st["y_px"] = int(round(y * H))
            st["y"] = y
            st.setdefault("color", "FFFFFF")
            return st

        if s.title:
            st = style("title")
            if st.get("card") and tl[0].kind == "card":
                st["y_px"], st["x_px"], st["fade_in"], st["fade_out"] = H // 2, W // 2, 400, 300
                texts.append(Text(kind="title", text=_cased(s.title, case), start=0.2, end=tl[0].length - 0.1, style=st))
                self.decide(ctx, rep, f"title card on black ({st['font']}), {tl[0].length:.1f}s")
            else:
                a = c_start + 0.2
                texts.append(Text(kind="title", text=_cased(s.title, case), start=a,
                                  end=min(a + float(st.get("dur", 2.4)), c_end - 0.2), style=st))
                self.decide(ctx, rep, f"title over the opening shot ({st['font']})")
        story_from = c_start + 0.25
        if s.stamp:
            st = style("stamp")
            dur = float(st.get("dur", 2.0))
            a = c_start + 0.2
            b = c_end - 0.3 if dur > 60 else min(a + dur, c_end - 0.3)
            texts.append(Text(kind="stamp", text=_cased(s.stamp, case), start=a, end=b, style=st))
            if dur <= 60:
                story_from = b + 0.15
            self.decide(ctx, rep, f"stamp '{_cased(s.stamp, case)}' {'for the whole film' if dur > 60 else f'for {b - a:.1f}s'}")
        lines = [ln.strip() for ln in s.story if ln.strip()]
        placed = 0
        if lines and T.get("words"):
            placed = self._kinetic(ctx, lines, texts, style("story"), case, story_from, c_end - 0.3)
        elif lines:
            st0 = style("story")
            reads = [min(max(0.75 + 0.3 * len(ln.split()), 1.3), 4.0) for ln in lines]
            avail = (c_end - 0.4) - story_from
            need = sum(reads) + 0.25 * (len(lines) - 1)
            scale = min(1.0, avail / need) if need > 0 else 1.0
            t = story_from
            for ln, r in zip(lines, reads):
                d = r * scale
                if d < 1.0 or t + 1.0 > c_end - 0.2:
                    break
                nxt = [c for c in cuts if t - 1e-3 <= c <= t + 0.45]
                if nxt and nxt[0] + d <= c_end - 0.2:
                    t = nxt[0] + 0.05
                texts.append(Text(kind="story", text=_cased(ln, case), start=round(t, 3), end=round(min(t + d, c_end - 0.2), 3),
                                  style=dict(st0)))
                placed += 1
                t += d + 0.25 * scale
            if scale < 1:
                self.decide(ctx, rep, f"{len(lines)} lines need {need:.1f}s, the edit has {avail:.1f}s: reading time "
                                      f"tightened to {scale:.0%}")
        if lines:
            ok = placed == len(lines)
            hint = {}
            if not ok and not s.length:
                hint = {"length_scale": round(min(2.0, (sum(min(max(0.75 + 0.3 * len(ln.split()), 1.3), 4.0) for ln in lines)
                                                       + 0.3 * len(lines)) / max(c_end - story_from, 1)), 2)}
            self.check(ctx, rep, "every story line placed", ok, f"{placed}/{len(lines)} lines on screen",
                       owner="cutter" if hint else None, hint=hint)
        if s.end_card:
            st = style("end")
            if st.get("card") and tl[-1].kind == "card":
                st["y_px"], st["x_px"], st["fade_in"], st["fade_out"] = H // 2, W // 2, 350, 300
                texts.append(Text(kind="end", text=_cased(s.end_card, case), start=tl[-1].start + 0.15,
                                  end=tl[-1].start + tl[-1].length - 0.05, style=st))
            else:
                texts.append(Text(kind="end", text=_cased(s.end_card, case), start=max(c_end - 2.2, c_start),
                                  end=c_end - 0.1, style=style("end")))
        self._legibility(ctx, rep, texts, W, H)
        p.texts = texts
        install_fonts(ctx)
        ass = ctx.root / "render" / "text.ass"
        ass.write_text(ass_document(W, H, texts), encoding="utf-8")
        self.check(ctx, rep, "text inside the frame", all(0 <= t.style["y_px"] <= H for t in texts), f"{len(texts)} text events")
        rep.summary = f"{len(texts)} text events" + (f" · {placed}/{len(lines)} story lines" if lines else "")
        self._preview(ctx, rep, texts, W, H)

    def _kinetic(self, ctx: Ctx, lines: list[str], texts: list[Text], st: dict, case: str, a: float, b: float) -> int:
        p = ctx.project
        beats = []
        if p.track and ctx.settings.beat_sync:
            beats = [x - p.audio.music_in for x in p.track.beats if a <= x - p.audio.music_in <= b]
        if len(beats) < 2:
            beats = list(np.arange(a, b, 0.34))
        i, placed = 0, 0
        for ln in lines:
            words = ln.split()
            if i + len(words) >= len(beats):
                break
            for k, w in enumerate(words):
                end = beats[i + 1] if k < len(words) - 1 else min(beats[i + 1] + 0.25, b)
                texts.append(Text(kind="word", text=_cased(w, case), start=round(beats[i], 3), end=round(end, 3),
                                  style=dict(st, fade_in=0, fade_out=60)))
                i += 1
            i += 1
            placed += 1
        self.decide(ctx, rep=ctx.project.agents["typographer"], msg=f"kinetic words: {placed} lines, one word per beat") \
            if "typographer" in ctx.project.agents else None
        return placed

    def _legibility(self, ctx: Ctx, rep: AgentRun, texts: list[Text], W: int, H: int) -> None:
        p = ctx.project
        cache: dict[str, dict] = {}
        lk = ctx.skill.get("look") or {}
        strength = float(p.look.get("strength", 1.0))
        shaded = []
        for tx in texts:
            mid = (tx.start + tx.end) / 2
            g = next((g for g in p.timeline if g.kind == "clip" and g.start <= mid < g.start + g.length), None)
            if g is None:
                continue
            c = p.clip(g.clip)
            d = cache.setdefault(c.id, load_analysis(ctx, c))
            src_t = g.src_in + (mid - g.start) * g.speed
            k = int(np.argmin(np.abs(d["t"] - src_t)))
            img = d["th"][k].astype(np.float32) / 255
            prim = (p.look.get("primary") or {}).get(c.id)
            if prim:
                img = look.grade_fn(prim, lk, strength)(img.reshape(-1, 3)).reshape(img.shape)
            ih, iw = img.shape[:2]
            s_ = max(W / c.width, H / c.height)
            vw, vh = min(1.0, W / (c.width * s_)), min(1.0, H / (c.height * s_))
            cx = (g.x0 + g.x1) / 2 if g.fill == "crop" else 0.5
            col0 = min(max(cx - vw / 2, 0), 1 - vw)
            row0 = (1 - vh) / 2
            half = tx.style["px"] / H * 0.9
            r_a, r_b = row0 + (tx.style["y"] - half) * vh, row0 + (tx.style["y"] + half) * vh
            c_a, c_b = col0 + 0.2 * vw, col0 + 0.8 * vw
            region = img[max(0, int(r_a * ih)):max(int(r_a * ih) + 1, int(r_b * ih)), max(0, int(c_a * iw)):max(int(c_a * iw) + 1, int(c_b * iw))]
            lum = float(look.luma(region).mean()) if region.size else 0.0
            tx.style["bg_luma"] = round(lum, 3)
            if lum > 0.58 and tx.kind in ("story", "stamp", "title", "word", "end"):
                tx.style["shade"] = True
                tx.style["shadow"] = max(float(tx.style.get("shadow", 0.5)), 0.85)
                shaded.append(f"'{tx.text[:28]}' ({lum:.2f})")
        if shaded:
            self.decide(ctx, rep, f"bright background behind {len(shaded)} line(s) → soft shade added: " + ", ".join(shaded[:3]))
        over = [tx for tx in texts if tx.style.get("bg_luma") is not None]
        if over:
            worst = max(t.style["bg_luma"] for t in over)
            self.check(ctx, rep, "every line readable", all(t.style.get("shade") or t.style["bg_luma"] <= 0.58 for t in over),
                       f"brightest background {worst:.2f}" + (" (shaded)" if shaded else ""))

    def _preview(self, ctx: Ctx, rep: AgentRun, texts: list[Text], W: int, H: int) -> None:
        p = ctx.project
        pick = next((t for t in texts if t.kind in ("story", "word", "stamp")), None) or (texts[0] if texts else None)
        if pick is None:
            return
        mid = (pick.start + pick.end) / 2
        g = next((g for g in p.timeline if g.start <= mid < g.start + g.length), None)
        scale = 540 / max(W, H)
        sw, sh = round(W * scale / 2) * 2, round(H * scale / 2) * 2
        out = ctx.root / "stills" / "typographer.jpg"
        if g is not None and g.kind == "clip":
            c = p.clip(g.clip)
            still(ctx, c, g.src_in + (mid - g.start) * g.speed, out, sw, sh, lut=p.look.get("luts", {}).get(c.id),
                  fx=p.look.get("fx"), grain=0, x=(g.x0 + g.x1) / 2, zoom=g.zoom0, ass="render/text.ass", ass_t=mid,
                  fill=g.fill)
        else:
            ctx.ffmpeg(["-y", "-f", "lavfi", "-i", f"color=c=black:s={sw}x{sh}:d=1", "-vf",
                        f"setpts=PTS-STARTPTS+{mid:.3f}/TB,subtitles=render/text.ass:fontsdir=render/fonts",
                        "-frames:v", "1", ctx.rel(out)])
        rep.preview = "stills/typographer.jpg"

"""Mixer: builds the soundtrack and hits the platform's loudness target.

Music enters on the downbeat the Cutter chose and fades out with the picture; the footage's own sound sits
under it at the skill's level (or carries the edit alone), with short fades at every cut so nothing clicks;
music ducks under speech when the skill asks for it; two-pass EBU R128 normalisation, then a measured check.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import re

from ... import media
from ..model import AgentRun
from .base import Agent, Ctx


def _atempo(speed: float) -> str:
    if abs(speed - 1) < 1e-3:
        return ""
    s, stages = speed, []
    while s < 0.5 or s > 2.0:
        stages.append(0.5 if s < 0.5 else 2.0)
        s /= stages[-1]
    return "," + ",".join(f"atempo={x}" for x in [*stages, round(s, 5)])


class Mixer(Agent):
    key, title, icon, color = "mixer", "Mixer", "wave", "#73daca"
    role = "builds the soundtrack: music from the chosen downbeat, the footage's sound under it, ducking, fades, loudness"
    needs = ("motion", "music")

    def inputs(self, ctx: Ctx):
        p, s = ctx.project, ctx.settings
        return [[(g.kind, g.clip, g.src_in, g.src_out, g.speed, g.start, g.length) for g in p.timeline],
                p.track.path if p.track else None, p.audio.music_in, ctx.skill.get("sound"), s.music_level, s.ambient,
                ctx.hints.get("mixer")]

    def run(self, ctx: Ctx, rep: AgentRun) -> None:
        p, s = ctx.project, ctx.settings
        snd = dict(ctx.skill.get("sound") or {})
        T = p.duration
        a = p.audio
        a.music = p.track.path if p.track else None
        a.music_db = float(snd.get("music_db", -3)) + float(s.music_level)
        a.ambient_db = float(s.ambient if s.ambient is not None else snd.get("ambient_db", -18))
        a.lufs = float(snd.get("lufs", -14))
        has_amb = any(p.clip(g.clip).has_audio for g in p.timeline if g.kind == "clip") and a.ambient_db > -50
        a.duck = bool(snd.get("duck")) and has_amb and any(p.clip(g.clip).sound for g in p.timeline if g.kind == "clip")
        last = p.timeline[-1]
        a.fade_out = round(min(3.0, max(1.2, last.length * 0.7 if last.kind == "card" else 2.0)), 2)
        work = ctx.root / "render"
        work.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        inputs, filters, amb = [], [], []
        n = 0
        if has_amb:
            for g in p.timeline:
                if g.kind != "clip" or not p.clip(g.clip).has_audio:
                    continue
                span = g.src_out - g.src_in
                inputs += ["-ss", f"{g.src_in:.4f}", "-t", f"{span:.4f}", "-i", p.clip(g.clip).master]
                L = g.length
                fi = max(0.02, g.fade_in)
                fo = max(0.02, g.fade_out)
                filters.append(f"[{n}:a]aresample=48000,aformat=channel_layouts=stereo{_atempo(g.speed)},"
                               f"volume={a.ambient_db:.1f}dB,afade=t=in:st=0:d={fi:.3f},"
                               f"afade=t=out:st={max(L - fo, 0):.3f}:d={fo:.3f},adelay={int(g.start * 1000)}:all=1[a{n}]")
                amb.append(f"[a{n}]")
                n += 1
        mus = None
        if a.music:
            path = ctx.abs(a.music)
            inputs += ["-ss", f"{a.music_in:.4f}", "-t", f"{T + 0.5:.3f}", "-i", str(path)]
            filters.append(f"[{n}:a]aresample=48000,aformat=channel_layouts=stereo,volume={a.music_db:.1f}dB,"
                           f"afade=t=in:st=0:d={a.fade_in:.3f},afade=t=out:st={max(T - a.fade_out, 0):.3f}:d={a.fade_out:.3f}[mus]")
            mus = "[mus]"
            n += 1
        if amb:
            filters.append(f"{''.join(amb)}amix=inputs={len(amb)}:normalize=0:duration=longest[amb]" if len(amb) > 1
                           else f"{amb[0]}anull[amb]")
        if mus and amb and a.duck:
            filters.append("[amb]asplit=2[amb1][sc]")
            filters.append("[mus][sc]sidechaincompress=threshold=0.03:ratio=6:attack=20:release=450[musd]")
            filters.append("[amb1][musd]amix=inputs=2:normalize=0:duration=longest[mix]")
        elif mus and amb:
            filters.append("[amb][mus]amix=inputs=2:normalize=0:duration=longest[mix]")
        elif mus:
            filters.append("[mus]anull[mix]")
        elif amb:
            filters.append("[amb]anull[mix]")
        raw = work / "mix_raw.wav"
        out = work / "audio.wav"
        if not filters:
            ctx.ffmpeg(["-y", "-f", "lavfi", "-i", "anullsrc=r=48000:cl=stereo", "-t", f"{T:.4f}", "-c:a", "pcm_s16le",
                        ctx.rel(out)])
            self.decide(ctx, rep, "no music and silent footage: a silent track")
            a.file = ctx.rel(out)
            rep.summary = "silent"
            return
        filters.append(f"[mix]apad,atrim=0:{T:.4f},alimiter=limit=0.95:level=disabled[out]")
        ctx.ffmpeg(["-y", *inputs, "-filter_complex", ";".join(filters), "-map", "[out]", "-c:a", "pcm_s16le",
                    "-ar", "48000", ctx.rel(raw)])
        meas = ctx.ffmpeg(["-i", ctx.rel(raw), "-af", f"loudnorm=I={a.lufs}:TP=-1.0:LRA=11:print_format=json",
                           "-f", "null", "-"]).stderr
        m = re.search(r"\{[^{}]*\"input_i\"[^{}]*\}", meas, re.S)
        if m:
            d = json.loads(m.group())
            af = (f"loudnorm=I={a.lufs}:TP=-1.0:LRA=11:measured_I={d['input_i']}:measured_TP={d['input_tp']}:"
                  f"measured_LRA={d['input_lra']}:measured_thresh={d['input_thresh']}:offset={d['target_offset']}:linear=true")
            ctx.ffmpeg(["-y", "-i", ctx.rel(raw), "-af", af, "-ar", "48000", "-c:a", "pcm_s16le", ctx.rel(out)])
        else:
            raw.replace(out)
        a.file = ctx.rel(out)
        parts = []
        if a.music:
            parts.append(f"music {p.track.name} from {a.music_in:.2f}s at {a.music_db:+.0f} dB, fading out over {a.fade_out:.1f}s")
        if amb:
            parts.append(f"footage sound at {a.ambient_db:+.0f} dB with 20 ms fades at every cut")
        if a.duck:
            parts.append("music ducks under speech")
        for t in parts:
            self.decide(ctx, rep, t)
        loud = media.loudness(out)
        if loud:
            ok = abs(loud["lufs"] - a.lufs) <= 1.0 and loud["true_peak"] <= -0.5
            self.check(ctx, rep, "loudness", ok, f"{loud['lufs']:.1f} LUFS (target {a.lufs:g}), true peak {loud['true_peak']:.1f} dBTP")
        rep.summary = (f"{p.track.name} · " if a.music else "") + f"{a.lufs:g} LUFS"
